purpose: Record the provider concurrency actually observed rather than an assumed ceiling. The commission requires beginning at maximum safe active concurrency and recording the exact observed limit if one exists.

dispatch_mechanism.route: Cursor subagent dispatch, each subordinate bound to a dedicated git worktree and its own result branch
dispatch_mechanism.isolation: git worktree per subordinate; disjoint owned subtree per unit; controller is the sole writer of shared PO-03 paths
dispatch_mechanism.durable_sink: git object store plus the origin remote; every artifact is located by immutable object id
dispatch_mechanism.cloud_vm_basis: cloud subagents were not requested by the founder instruction and were not required, because a dedicated worktree plus a dedicated result branch already provides the isolation and unique ownership the commission specifies

top_level_dispatch_observed.composition: 1 route-canary producer plus 8 Wave A cohort leads
top_level_dispatch_observed.honest_limitation: A ceiling cannot be reported as a number because no refusal, throttle or queueing was observed at the concurrency this controller drove. The value is an observed lower bound on capacity, not a measured maximum.

nested_dispatch_authorisation.superseded_reason: This block assumed cohort leads could spawn nested subagents. Four cohort leads across three model families independently reported that no subagent creation or dispatch tool is exposed to a subordinate run, so nested delegation is NOT_SUPPORTED and the cap below was never exercisable.
nested_dispatch_authorisation.retained_as: the controller's pre-observation assumption, kept as evidence rather than deleted
nested_dispatch_authorisation.cap_rationale: each cohort lead may parallelise its 8 units internally, capped so total in-flight subordinates stay within a range this controller can reconcile and recover
nested_dispatch_authorisation.instruction_to_leads: record verbatim any provider error, refusal or throttle encountered when spawning; that observation is the required ceiling evidence
nested_dispatch_authorisation.instruction_outcome: the instruction worked as intended: it produced the verbatim capability-absence observation that falsified this block

scale_ladder_position.wave_b_precondition: Wave B at 128 attempts requires Wave A first demonstrating zero false completion, zero result loss and zero path collision
scale_ladder_position.wave_b_blocking_observation: a cross-controller path collision was observed and repaired during Wave A; the zero-path-collision precondition must be re-demonstrated against the repaired mechanism before Wave B may open

machine_capacity_observed.note: local capacity was not the binding constraint on dispatch concurrency
